purpose_context: When two approved lanes conflict, consolidate currently tells operators to resolve and commit on the lane, then refuses that commit as unreviewed content; the rollback also erases the state the advice refers to. This mission names and makes executable the sanctioned route (re-review and re-approval of the resolution), refuses unreviewed resolutions early with a clear message, closes related soundness gaps, and keeps unreviewed content from ever landing.
purpose_tldr: Make consolidate's stale-lane advice and its reconciliation gate agree on how a conflict between approved lanes is resolved, so operators get one working, reviewed route instead of advice that leads into a refusal.
